includes: Access to flying sites with USHPA membership
blurb: The North Cascades Soaring Club administers several paragliding and hang gliding sites near Bellingham, WA, including Black Mountain, Blanchard Mountain, and Big Johnson. Sites require USHPA membership and site orientation before flying. Access is generally hike-in only, with no recreational drive-up access currently permitted.
extraNote: Membership can be recurring and canceled anytime via PayPal · Sites may be closed during dry season due to high fire danger and during winter due to snow · No smoking, no fires, no tree cutting, camping, or unrelated activities at sites · Keys to gated sites are not transferable and must be used responsibly · Year-round with seasonal closures due to fire danger and snow
